grain: one compiled visual profile, not one keyword or rendered image
limitations: Population is the local photo skill registry, not usage logs.
Counts have mixed semantic granularity; shares do not establish coverage or user demand.
Hangul detection measures authored Korean text, not multilingual embedding comprehension.
Similar vectors are review leads, not automatic duplicate judgments.
No embedding API, image generation, pixel review, or runtime data changes.

highest_pairs.left_definition: highlight tonal regions share a warm color tendency across separate surfaces; shadow tonal regions share a cool tendency with controlled transitions through midtones
highest_pairs.right_definition: highlight tonal regions share a cool color tendency across separate surfaces; shadow tonal regions share a warm tendency with controlled transitions through midtones

highest_pairs.left_definition: An adult hourglass-family silhouette with visible upper-torso and hip expansion around a narrower natural waist, where the upper expansion is directionally more dominant than the lower expansion without becoming a waistless inverted triangle.
highest_pairs.right_definition: An adult hourglass-family silhouette with visible upper-torso and hip expansion around a narrower natural waist, where the lower hip and upper-thigh expansion is directionally more dominant than the upper expansion without becoming a waistless triangle.

highest_pairs.left_definition: a readable foreground plane carries relatively warm hues; a separate distant plane carries relatively cool hues with visible depth cues
highest_pairs.right_definition: a readable foreground plane carries relatively cool hues; a separate distant plane carries relatively warm hues with visible depth cues

highest_pairs.left_definition: A turned face presents one visibly broader cheek plane to the camera and that broader visible plane receives the dominant light, while the narrower far plane carries the primary shadow.
highest_pairs.right_definition: A turned face presents one narrow far cheek plane to the camera and that narrow plane receives the dominant light, leaving the broader camera-facing cheek in modeled shadow.

highest_pairs.left_definition: the dominant directional illumination has a visible color tint; the weaker fill contribution remains relatively neutral on its receiving regions
highest_pairs.right_definition: the dominant directional illumination remains relatively neutral; the weaker fill contribution adds visible color to its receiving regions

highest_pairs.left_definition: the subject contains more distinct principal hue families than the background; the background keeps fewer hue families even where its texture is detailed
highest_pairs.right_definition: the background contains more distinct principal hue families than the subject; the subject keeps fewer hue families even where its texture is detailed
